title: Home previews
question: Three looks for the same home. Malote is the locked brief. Space and neumorphism are the two new previews.

options.label: Malote
options.lineage: A messenger pouch of onion-skin slips
options.thesis: You hold the blank slip to dictate, then clip it into the day’s pouch or tear it up.
options.viewport: Portrait. Pronto stamped on the flap, seven timed slips, and a Segurar slip flush at the bottom.
options.risk: The stack gets hard to scan if the slips overlap enough to hide a line.

options.label: Espaço
options.lineage: A dark instrument panel in a quiet starfield
options.thesis: The day is seven instrument rows, and Segurar is a cyan plate you hold.
options.viewport: Portrait. Rafael and Pronto on a thin bar, seven dark rows, a Segurar plate flush at the bottom.
options.risk: Reads as a generic dark app if the starfield and the cyan plate are the only space cues.

options.label: Neumorfismo
options.lineage: Soft extruded gray, one light from the top left
options.thesis: Every row is a pressed well, and Segurar is a raised pill in the same gray.
options.viewport: Portrait. A raised Rafael bar, seven inset rows, and a raised Segurar pill.
options.risk: The wells disappear if the shadows get too faint and the type loses contrast.
